description: Use when your human picked an offer from find_offers. Returns the one page where they buy it: they press Buy there and pay on a secure payment page. This call never buys anything. Pass api_key so the visit counts for you.

api_key.description: Your OpenMyPro agent key (omp_ak_ plus 32 hex). Optional when the connection already sends Authorization: Bearer.

name: get_checkout_link
title: Get the page where your human buys an offer
